name: Facade weathering rules
about: Numeric rules for building weathering, measured in facade space (metres) on a darkening map D = 1 - Y_weathered / Y_clean. A configuration is accepted only when every binding rule passes. Origins: U = the user's review notes (review 36), P = measured on the reference photos, L = building physics and the soiling literature, C = craft estimate (to recalibrate with picks).

definitions.D: darkening of albedo luminance against the same surface with no weathering: 0 clean, 0.10 = 10 % darker, negative = lighter

tiers.note: each tier is about 1.6-2x the one below; T1 is near the threshold of seeing on a pale wall (about 1 L*), T4 is a clear stain, T6 a black crust

levels.below: under 12.5 cm is the material's own texture (grain, pores, coat bumps): the material set and the tiling detail, checked by J rules on close crops

clock.note: a building is on average two-thirds of the way through its repaint cycle, and 17 % of the dirt survives each repaint. Round H: rounds F and G both had the user pick the next-cleaner preset as the 35-year default; the old clock (the cycle's end, 22 % kept) made every age one level too weathered. Damage, cracks, rust, efflorescence, edges and fading follow age, not E

definitions.planes: exposed painted faces visible in elevation: front plane (parapets, slab edges), the walls above the parapets, end walls (gables), the plinth; soffits and recesses are sheltered planes
definitions.D_local: the weathering's own local contrast: D_local = 1 - (1 - D) / ref, ref = the least weathered 10 cm patch within +-1 m (smoothed), on 4 cm block means. A uniform darkening of a whole wall gives 0 (it reads as a paint colour, not as weathering: the user, review 36); paint tones that differ from element to element do not count either. T1 is below photo noise and material texture, so the amount rules start at T2. Arris rows and the edge layer's pixels are left out (the edge rules N1-N5 measure them).

kept.label: Kept
kept.anchor: U (round G): 'something between New and Kept, which will become the new kept'

typical.label: Typical (default)
typical.anchor: U (round G): round G's Kept picked as the default street block on the front and at 1:1; 'the current Kept becomes Typical'

derelict.label: Derelict
derelict.anchor: U (round G): 'Worn currently is probably more like derelict levels of weathering... Worn becomes Derelict'

coverage.about: A1: share of the exposed painted wall at or above each tier of D_local (T2+ ... T6+), by preset; interpolate in E. Anchors: U, round-7 'Light' (picked for a moderately kept block) measured T3+ 0.16, T4+ 0.057, T5+ 0.025; P, ordinary photo walls median T3+ 0.52, T4+ 0.09, T5+ 0.034 (range 0.08-0.66, 0.05-0.25, 0.02-0.12), heavily stained walls T3+ 0.88-0.98, T4+ 0.63-0.96; U, round-7 Neglected (0.49, 0.24, 0.087) was 'not heavy enough'. The New band allows the material's own variation. Round F: re-measured with D_local on the weathering alone; round-7 'Light' then reads 0.35 / 0.13 / 0.041 / 0.011 / 0.001 (inside Kept), round-7 'Medium' 0.64 / 0.44 / 0.17 / 0.039 / 0.004 (Worn's T5+ and T6+ lower bounds moved to 0.035 and 0.004 to hold it), round-7 Neglected 0.76 / 0.52 / 0.25 / 0.072 / 0.011 (still below Neglected: 'not heavy enough'). Round G: the user picked the Kept image as the default street block (35 years, upkeep 0.9) on the front and on the 1:1 top floors, so Typical takes Kept's round-F bands; Kept is about 0.6x; Worn between Typical and Neglected; Neglected unchanged ('about right'). Round H: as the tone, the presets moved onto these anchors through the clock (the user's rename); the bands did not change.

rules.title: Overall greying follows age and upkeep
rules.measure: mean D against clean on all exposed painted planes (area-weighted)
rules.pass: inside the 'tone' band at the config's E
rules.origin: U+C

rules.title: Marks cover more of the wall, at more intensities, with age and neglect
rules.measure: share of exposed painted wall at each tier of D_local (T2+ ... T6+), area-weighted
rules.pass: every tier inside its 'coverage' band at the config's E
rules.origin: U+P

rules.title: No clean sections
rules.measure: D_local cell means on 4 m cells (S3) per plane
rules.pass: P10 cell >= 0.30 x mean, and min cell >= 0.15 x mean, when E >= 10; >= 0.40 / 0.25 when E >= 25
rules.origin: U ('that middle section has virtually no wear or stain')

rules.title: Edges carry weathering too
rules.measure: mean D_local in the outer 1 m bands of each plane (both vertical ends, and the 1 m under the wall top) over the plane mean
rules.origin: U ('the edge areas also have no staining')

rules.title: Presets order at every tier
rules.measure: composite tier coverage across the presets new < kept < typical < worn < derelict; and the ground band: base excess (bottom 1 m over the wall mean, minus 1) per preset, as steps over its New-to-Derelict range
rules.pass: strictly increasing at T1+..T5+ (ties allowed only where both are below 0.001); ground band steps <= 0.45 of the range, the New-to-Kept step <= 0.30
rules.origin: C; U (round F: 'the jumps between the steps for the ground level could be more subtle')

rules.title: Seeds of a preset read as the same age
rules.measure: the seeds of one preset: tone (A0), T3+ and T4+ of D_local, and the film contrast the solver used
rules.pass: each within its tolerance of the seeds' mean: tone 4 %, T3+ 7 %, T4+ 8 %, film contrast 2 %
rules.origin: U (round G: 'Seed 1 looks stronger, 2 and 3 look a little closer'; seed 1 measured T3+ 0.205 and T4+ 0.086 against 0.185-0.191 and 0.071-0.079, film contrast 0.69 against 0.61 and 0.50)

rules.title: The presets step evenly
rules.measure: tone (A0) steps from New up the preset ladder
rules.pass: largest step over the smallest <= 2.2, every step > 0
rules.origin: U (round G: 'Yes, even steps' for a ladder measuring 1.9); C (the margin)

rules.title: A range of opacities, more faint than heavy while the wall is kept
rules.measure: shares of the exposed painted wall in each D_local tier band T2..T6
rules.pass: when E >= 10: at least 4 tiers each hold >= 1 % of the wall, and no tier holds more than 60 % of the stained area (T2+), 70 % when E < 12; when 10 <= E <= 20 the share falls from T3 upward (each ratio <= 0.9)
rules.origin: U ('It's also levels like opacities and concentrations'); P (heavy photo walls shift to the dark tiers, so the falling rule stops at E 20)

rules.title: Large marks have an inner pattern
rules.measure: connected marks of D_local >= T3 with equivalent diameter >= 0.5 m: coefficient of variation of D_local inside, and the number of tiers spanned
rules.pass: median CV >= 0.30 and >= 60 % of them span >= 3 tiers (reach T5); marks >= 2 m: median CV >= 0.40, 10th percentile >= 0.33, none under 0.25 (when E >= 25: 0.33, 0.25, 0.20)
rules.origin: U ('large blotches need inner patterns and varying intensity'); P (recalibrated on D_local of the photo walls, round F: ordinary walls 9 of 14 marks >= 0.5 m span >= 3 tiers, median CV about 0.35, marks >= 2 m CV 0.35-0.68; heavy walls 0.25-0.58)

rules.title: No flat tint
rules.measure: share of the stained footprint (D >= T1) whose local std over 20 cm is below 0.005
rules.pass: <= 0.05 for the composite and for the soiling layer
rules.origin: U ('looks like you're just changing the base color'); P (photos: 0.00)

rules.title: Energy at every scale level
rules.measure: std of the composite's difference-of-Gaussian band per level (S2-S8 that fit the plane)
rules.pass: every level >= 0.004 when E >= 10, and max/min over S3-S8 <= 3.0
rules.origin: U ('micro, mid, and macro... EIGHT levels of scale'); P (photo walls: flat to rising band std, max/min 1.3-2.6)

rules.title: Each areal layer spans macro, mid and micro
rules.measure: per layer (soiling, stains, base, bio): levels whose band std >= 15 % of the layer's largest band
rules.pass: at least one level in each group (macro, mid, micro) and >= 5 levels in all
rules.origin: U

rules.title: More small marks than large
rules.measure: count of connected marks per level at D >= T2, per layer (streaks, stains, bio, damage)
rules.pass: count(S_k+1) >= 1.5 x count(S_k) for every level k with count >= 10, down to S7
rules.origin: C (power-law sizes)

rules.title: 80/20 at several scales, with a background
rules.measure: share of the summed D_local held by the top 20 % of cells, on 4 m and 2 m cells, per plane; streak and stain layers on their own maps
rules.pass: composite in [0.28, 0.60]; streak and stain layers in [0.40, 0.85] on planes where the layer covers >= 3 % at T2+
rules.origin: U ('the 80/20 applies at various levels, and it isn't necessarily as simple as on/off'); P (photo walls 0.26-0.35 on 1 m cells against a local reference)

rules.title: Variety without jumping all over
rules.measure: per storey-bay cells of D_local on each plane, storeys only (the roof parapet or coping band above the top slab and the ground storey's splash zone are systematic and have their own rules, A3/F1 and F3): lag-1 correlation of neighbours (storey to storey, bay to bay), and the P90 of the storey-to-storey difference over the P90-P10 spread; bay to bay compares neighbouring bays of the same kind (unit next to unit)
rules.pass: rho floor-to-floor >= 0.30, rho bay-to-bay >= 0.20, jump <= 0.80
rules.origin: U ('too much of a difference between that upper floor and the one immediately under it'); P (photos: rho 0.1-0.9, jump 0.3-0.8)

rules.title: Top more intense than the middle
rules.measure: mean D of the streak + stain layers in the top 20 % of each wall's height over the 30-70 % band
rules.origin: U ('I'd expect the ones near the top to be more intense'); L (driven rain peaks at the top); P (photo walls median 1.4)

rules.title: Each run is darkest at its source
rules.measure: streak and stain marks taller than 0.5 m: mean D of the top third over the bottom third
rules.pass: median >= 1.25
rules.origin: L (run-off deposits most near its source); U

rules.title: Darker base
rules.measure: mean D of the dirt (damage, cracks, crack repairs and edges left out) in the bottom 1 m of each wall over the wall mean
rules.origin: P (photo walls 1.3-2.0); L (splash, damp, soil); U (round F: the ground band should come in gently)

rules.title: North and damp faces grow more
rules.measure: bio layer coverage at T2+ on north-facing planes over south-facing
rules.pass: >= 1.5 when bio is present
rules.origin: L

rules.title: Streaks start at a feature
rules.measure: share of streak marks whose top lies within 0.15 m below a source pixel (ledge and slab drip line, the drip edge under copings and roof props, joint crossings, sill end, opening corner, fixing, joint, chip, top edge)
rules.origin: P (review 31: every streak in 17 photos starts at a feature); L

rules.title: Stains are dark on every material
rules.measure: on dark substrates (plinth, bare concrete; clean Y < 0.30): share of pixels lighter than the clean surface by more than T2, and lightening marks taller than 0.3 m
rules.pass: <= 0.02 and none; passes when the building has no dark substrate
rules.origin: U ('I'd expect stains to be dark somewhat independently of the materials')

rules.title: Lightening is rare and specific
rules.measure: share of each plane lighter than clean by more than T1 (washed, worn, efflorescence, fading, repaint)
rules.pass: <= 0.25 x the plane's share at T1+ darkening
rules.origin: C; L (white washing is a late-life feature, 2 of 23 photos)

rules.title: Algae sits where water stays
rules.measure: share of the algae layer's darkening in the wet zone: the bottom 1.5 m, within 0.8 m below a water source (tops, sill ends, corner heads, fixings, joints, stain and streak marks), or in a joint
rules.pass: >= 60 % wherever algae covers >= 0.2 % of a plane at T2+
rules.origin: U ('growth and algae/mold stains from the water'); L (algae needs standing or running water; it starts at the foot, under drips and in joints)

rules.title: Seam crossings collect a little more
rules.measure: where a horizontal and a vertical joint cross: mean D on the joint pixels within 4 cm of the crossing over the joint pixels 0.2-0.6 m from it, per plane
rules.pass: in [1.15, 2.0] wherever the streak amount is 0.2 or more
rules.origin: U (round F: 'the intersecting corners where seams cross could use a little more. Just a tiny adjustment, don't overdo it'); L (water meets and pauses where joints cross); round F measured 1.02-1.07

rules.title: No accidental lattice
rules.measure: per plane, axis and map (soiling, stains, streaks, base, growth, D) on painted wall: the edge-energy profile's periodogram over its running median; the harmonic sum over the first 8 harmonics for periods of 16-600 px, the building's own rhythm (floor pitch, twice it, bay pitch, the 1.8 m scaffold lift, the peaks of the wall's feature map with its joints) left out; a layer is scanned on an axis only where it spans a third of it
rules.pass: the largest harmonic sum <= 9
rules.origin: U (round F: the grime reads as a grid); roundG/research/grid-breakup.md 5.1-5.2 (tile-free controls 4.0-7.9; round F's soiling 12.8 from the 3.6 m material tile; measured here 13.5-26 on round F's fronts)

rules.title: The wall is not striped
rules.measure: composite anisotropy gx/gy of the S5-S8 bands
rules.origin: P (photo walls 0.5-1.6; round-7 renders 2.6-4.0)

rules.title: Streaks read as streaks, stains as stains
rules.measure: anisotropy of the streak layer's S7-S8 bands; of the stain layer's S4-S6 bands
rules.pass: streaks >= 2.0; stains in [0.5, 2.0]
rules.origin: U ('the big blotches blend a little too well with the long streaks'); C, calibrated on synthetic marks: a single 1 m x 3 cm streak measures 1.69 / 2.34 / 3.23 at S6 / S7 / S8, a 0.4 m drip 1.14 / 1.51 / 2.13, a fringe of drips 0.43 / 0.80 / 1.29, stains about 1.5

rules.title: Streak cores show through stains
rules.measure: where streak cores (streak layer >= T3) lie inside stains (stain layer >= T2): composite D at the core minus the mean over a 15-30 cm ring
rules.pass: median >= 0.03
rules.origin: U

rules.title: Long streaks, some near the whole height
rules.measure: per wall of 3 storeys or more: the longest vertical run of the streak layer at T2+ (gaps under 0.6 m bridged: slabs, windows) as a share of the wall height; distinct runs of 3 m or more per 25 m of width
rules.pass: reach >= 0.35 + 0.40 x the streak amount; runs >= 1 + 3.5 x the amount per 25 m; from amount 0.25
rules.origin: U (round F: 'more long vertical streaks', 'some near-whole building long streaks', 'some areas channel water more than others'); round F reached 0.22-0.61 of the wall with 0.6-3.6 runs per 25 m

rules.title: Some streaks much darker (layering)
rules.measure: streak-layer marks 0.3 m tall or more: the 90th percentile of their mean D over the median
rules.pass: >= 1.8 (20 marks or more, from amount 0.25)
rules.origin: U (round F: 'get darker (just some of them, not all, remember layering)'); round F measured 1.41-1.47; C (1.8)

rules.title: Dirt shifts colour like real dirt
rules.measure: soiling, streak and stain pixels at T3+ against clean: shift in b* (yellow-blue) and |a*| per 0.1 of D (bio and rust exempt)
rules.pass: b* shift in [-0.30, +0.80] per 0.1 D and |a*| <= 1.0 per 0.1 D
rules.origin: P (photo stains on painted walls: b* -0.26 to +0.67 and a* -0.9 to +0.2 per 0.1 D; a grey multiply gives about -0.16)

rules.title: More kinds of discolouration with neglect
rules.measure: number of layers covering >= 0.3 % of the wall at T2+ (or, for lightening layers, lighter than T1)
rules.pass: >= 3 at E >= 10, >= 5 at E >= 19, >= 7 at E >= 25 (soiling, streaks, stains, base, bio, rust, efflorescence, washed, fading, repaint, peeling, cracks)
rules.origin: U ('more varied wear, discoloration beyond just staining, growth and algae/mold stains')

rules.title: Weathering varies in colour like the reference walls
rules.measure: weathered pixels (D_local >= T3 on 4 cm blocks, growth and rust left out) on painted wall: the spread of their Lab shift against clean, the share shifted by 1.5 or more, and the spread between marks of 0.5 m or more, per wall; from E 10
rules.pass: spread 0.9-4.0; non-neutral share 0.12-0.80; mark-to-mark spread >= 0.2 where there are three marks or more
rules.origin: U (round F: more colour variety, calibrated on the photos); P (five ordinary photo walls: spread 1.2-3.9 over a clean-wall noise of 0.65-0.99, so 1.0-3.8 above noise; non-neutral 0.21-0.75 over a noise of 0-0.13; marks 0.2-0.84); round F's builds 0.24-0.89

rules.title: Dark green and yellow marks sit side by side
rules.measure: mark pixels (streaks, stains and the ground band at T2+ on paint, growth and rust left out) against clean: the green family (hue 100-180 deg, a* -1 or less), the yellow family (hue 70-100 deg, b* +3 or more), and the olive in between (hue 105-130 deg, chroma 2 or more) that a smooth blend would make; from E 8
rules.pass: green >= 5 %, yellow >= 4 %, neither over 35 %; every wall with 5000 mark pixels has both (2 % each); olive <= 0.35 x the smaller family
rules.origin: U (round G: 'work in a little more dark green and yellow. Not blended smoothly, but coexisting'); C (shares)

rules.title: Green marks darken with age
rules.measure: the green-family mark pixels across the presets at E 8 or more: their mean L* change and colour difference against clean
rules.pass: from each preset to the next older one: L* change down by 1.0 or more, colour difference up
rules.origin: U (round G: 'Remember what I said, mold and mildew darken/intensify with age')

rules.title: The material is not uniform or smooth
rules.measure: the clean material at the two resolutions the asset carries: relative std of the luminance band-pass at 10-50 cm and 0.5-2 m on each plane's clean albedo (50 px/m, the baked atlas), and at 0.5-2 cm and 2-10 cm on 1 m close-ups at 1 mm/px under the preview light (the coat set as the shader samples it); relief: RMS slope of the close-up height at 1-10 mm
rules.pass: each band in [1.2 %, 5 %] on every plane and close-up; relief RMS slope >= 2 degrees
rules.origin: U ('Concrete isn't uniform like this. And it's not smooth like this'); P (round E photo walls 1.9-3.6 %)

rules.title: Weathering follows the material
rules.measure: (a) correlation of the soiling layer with the material response (coat strength, laps, coat thickness, joints) in the 4-50 cm band on the painted walls; (b) mean soiling in the joints over the wall within 15 cm of them; (c) on each close-up, mean soiling in the deepest 20 % of the coat's cavities over the shallowest 50 %
rules.pass: (a) >= 0.25 pixel-weighted over the planes, (b) >= 1.3 where joints exist and E >= 10, (c) >= 1.3; when E >= 5
rules.origin: U ('the basic texture of the material... also informs the wear and tearing patterns, stains and streaks, biological growth...')

rules.title: Damage at many sizes, more levels with more damage
rules.measure: damage marks (chips, spalls) counted per level S4-S8 and below
rules.pass: the largest damage level present reaches S8 at amount 0.25, S7 at 0.5, S6 at 0.75, S5 at 1.0; from that level down to S8 the geometric mean count ratio per level is in [2, 6] and no step is below 1.3 (levels with >= 3 marks)
rules.origin: U ('micro, mid, and macro levels... EIGHT levels of scale')

rules.title: Each step of the damage control shows
rules.measure: damaged area and count between amount steps of 0.25
rules.pass: area x >= 1.6 and count x >= 1.5 per step
rules.origin: U ('they all look of a similar size of breaking, same distribution, and same overall amount')

rules.title: Edges first, clustered around a centre
rules.measure: share of chips centred within 10 cm of an exposed edge; share of chip area inside hotspot clusters (the rest is background chipping); chip size against distance from its hotspot centre, within each hotspot (median over hotspots with 6 or more satellites) (edge-damage clusters and background chips; delamination spalls follow K5 and K6)
rules.origin: L; U (round B: damage radiates from a centre)

rules.title: Breaks are sharp, rough and recessed
rules.measure: on the break coverage map, radial profiles (16 rays) across the outline of every break of 3 px radius or more, plane cuts left out: the width of the 0.9 to 0.1 ramp; inside breaks of 4 cm radius and up, the relative std of the albedo's 1.5 px high-pass; their median depth
rules.pass: median ramp <= 2 px (4 cm at 50 px/m); texture >= 0.035; depth 0.8-4.5 cm
rules.origin: L (a fracture edge is sharp at millimetre scale; a spall goes to the cover concrete, 2-4 cm, and shows aggregate); lead review, round F: at amount 0.75 the large breaks read as soft smudges (ramp 4.25 px, no depth)

rules.title: Spalled area by amount
rules.measure: share of the wall (paint and concrete) under a break (coverage >= 0.5)
rules.origin: U (round F: derelict at 1.0); L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md S1: 3.7-9.9 % at 75 years unmaintained); round F reached 0.54 % at 1.0

rules.title: Spalls start at edges
rules.measure: spalls 30 mm across or more: share within 150 mm of an arris
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md S5: corners, slab noses, sills, parapet tops)

rules.title: Cracks from hairline to pattern cracks
rules.measure: crack length per m2 of wall (width >= 0.05 mm), of cracks >= 0.3 mm, and the median width, pooled over exposed walls
rules.origin: U (round F: 'cracks from hairline to pattern cracks'); L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md C1, C2, C4); round F had about 0 m per m2 (no opening corners reached the crack layer)

rules.title: Cracks run mostly vertical
rules.measure: length-weighted crack orientation, pattern cracks left out
rules.pass: vertical 40-65 %, diagonal 20-40 %, horizontal 10-25 %
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md C7)

rules.title: Diagonal cracks start at opening corners
rules.measure: share of diagonal crack length within one opening width of an opening corner
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md C8: 45 deg cracks from window corners)

rules.title: Cracks read through what they carry
rules.measure: median delta L* of the 1 px crack line against the wall around it, by width class (repaired cracks left out)
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md C19 and 3.1: at 20 mm/px a crack shows through its halo, not its opening)

rules.title: Repaired cracks
rules.measure: share of the length of cracks >= 0.3 mm under a repair stripe
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md C23: U-cut and injected repairs on repainted danchi)

rules.title: A control widens coverage, not only opacity
rules.measure: per detail control, between sweep steps of 0.25: the layer's coverage at T2+ and at its top tier
rules.pass: each step widens the layer's coverage by >= 1.25x at its intensity frontier, the lowest tier covering under half the wall at the step below; and the intensity rises at least once per two steps: the top tier reached moves up, the frontier moves up, or the share of the layer's area at T4+ grows by >= 10 % (not for damage or rust: breaks and rust on the steel are full contrast at any amount; K2 and R2 check their steps). A step 'has some' of a layer at 0.2 % of the wall, or for damage at any break area: breaks are discrete
rules.origin: U ('The intensity should not only increase the opacity, but also the amount of surface covered by various levels of intensity')

rules.title: Each step is visible
rules.measure: between sweep steps: share of the plane where |delta D| >= 0.01, and mean |delta D| there
rules.pass: each step changes >= 2 % of a plane by >= 0.01 (or half the layer's own T2+ area if that is smaller), with a mean change >= 0.02
rules.origin: U ('I can't see a difference')

rules.title: Each step of a control looks as big as the last
rules.measure: per detail control over its steps above 0 (not damage, which K2 checks): the ratio between steps of the layer's mean D, and of its coverage at the frontier tier (the lowest tier under half the wall at the first step shown), while that coverage is under half the wall
rules.pass: largest ratio over smallest: <= 1.5 for the mean, <= 1.4 for the coverage
rules.origin: U (round F: stains 'the jump to 0.5 is pretty strong, but the jump to 0.75 and 1 feel smaller'; grime 'maybe 0.4 to 0.5 the jump is smaller than 0.3 to 0.4'); round F's stain sweep measured 1.88 and 1.71

rules.title: The control's top step is strong
rules.measure: at a sweep's last step (1.0): the layer's share of the exposed walls at T2+ and at T4+
rules.pass: streaks: >= 0.035 at T2+ and >= 0.012 at T4+
rules.origin: U (round F: 'Even the last is too weak... 1.00/100% should be more intense'); round F's 1.0 measured 0.023 and 0.008

rules.title: Light growth is a tint, not grey
rules.measure: growth pixels at T2-T3 (growth making most of the darkening) against clean: b* and a* shift per 0.1 of D; the share in a dull or rusty-yellow family (a* +0.3 or more, b* +3 or more per 0.1 D) and in the dirt band (b* <= +0.8)
rules.pass: b* +2.5 to +7.0 per 0.1 D; green family a* -3.0 to -0.4 per 0.1 D; yellow family 10-45 %; dirt band <= 10 %
rules.origin: U (round F: 'weaker growth should have a lighter green or very dull or rusty yellow look'); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O1: +4.4 to +5.5 b* and -1.5 to -1.9 a* per 0.1 D)

rules.title: Severe growth is dark green or rust brown
rules.measure: the darkest growth (growth's own darkening >= 0.55, N, E and W walls; south walls grow moulds, O8): black share (C* < 8); of the rest, C* 10-26, hue 95-135 deg (green) or 40-75 deg (rust), and the darkest quarter's L*; from 2000 pixels
rules.pass: black <= 35 %; chroma band >= 75 %; hue band >= 75 %; 25th percentile of L* <= 50
rules.origin: U (round F: 'the visibly dark green/rust brown look that severe growth has'); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O2)

rules.title: Growth sits where water stays
rules.measure: pooled over exposed walls: share of growth (T2+) in damp and wet zones (W2-W3, wetness >= 0.40); the cover of W2-W3 and of the open wall (W0-W1); the share in sunny open wall (W0, < 0.15)
rules.pass: >= 70 % in W2-W3 while growth covers under 5 %; beyond that, while W2-W3 are under 80 % covered, their cover >= 3x the open wall's; W0 <= 10 %
rules.origin: U (round F: corners, divots, edges, below ledges); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O4)

rules.title: Plinth belt
rules.measure: N, E and W walls: mean growth darkening in the bottom 0.3 m over the open wall (wetness < 0.4, not under another ledge or joint) 0.5-1.5 m above the foot; from 2 years of growth
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O5: belt 5-30 cm, splash zone 30 cm)

rules.title: Time unattended adds area grown from the old patches
rules.measure: the growth control's steps: growth area (T2+) ratio, the share of the added darkening on newly covered pixels, the share of old growth kept
rules.pass: area x >= 1.25 while W2-W3 are under 85 % covered; new share >= 50 %; kept >= 95 %
rules.origin: U (round F: 'algae and mold tend to grow outwards like tendrils or blobs, they don't merely get darker'); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O9)

rules.title: Ragged fronts, not smooth blobs
rules.measure: growth patches (T2+) of 60 px or more on walls where growth covers 3 % or more: perimeter-area dimension (2 x the slope of log perimeter on log area)
rules.origin: U ('tendrils or blobs'); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O12; box counting misread sparse patches, so the perimeter-area form)

rules.title: Onset by wetness class
rules.measure: growth (T2+) cover of each wetness class's area at the build's years unattended (3.1, 5.7, 10, 22 years at growth amounts 0.25-1.0, log-linear between)
rules.pass: W3 >= 15 % from 1 year and >= 50 % from 3; W2 >= 10 % from 3 years and >= 30 % from 8; W1 >= 3 % from 8 years; W0 <= 5 % up to 15 years; no class over its ceiling (W0 0.30, W1 0.60, W2 0.90, W3 0.95) + 0.03
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O11 and 3.3: onset, time scale and ceiling per class from field timings)

rules.title: Fronts grow outward
rules.measure: the growth control's steps: new growth (T2+) within 0.3 m of the previous step's growth (front growth) and farther away (new patches); a step from a wall with no growth yet (under 400 px) has no fronts and is not judged
rules.pass: front growth >= 70 %; new patches 5-30 %
rules.origin: U ('grow outwards'); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O10)

rules.title: Growth darkens and thickens with age
rules.measure: the growth control's steps: the pixels that were growth (T2+) at the earlier step, at the later step
rules.pass: their L* down by 1.0 or more and their growth darkening up by 0.02 or more per step
rules.origin: U (round G: 'mold and mildew darken/intensify with age'; round F: 'dark green/rust brown' when severe); L (roundG/research/organic-growth.md O2)

rules.title: Edges show at 0.25
rules.measure: the edge layer's mean |delta L*| on the 1 px edge row (painted wall)
rules.origin: U (round F: edge wear and discoloration visible at 0.25); L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md E9 and 5.5: at 20 mm/px visibility comes from the edge row, not a bevel)

rules.title: The edge band is broken at 0.25, near continuous at 1.0
rules.measure: share of edge length with the edge layer's |delta L*| >= 2
rules.pass: 40-70 % at 0.25 to 85-100 % at 1.0 (linear between)
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md E8)

rules.title: Visible chips
rules.measure: chips 20 mm across or more per m of edge
rules.pass: 0.04-0.15 at 0.25 to 0.5-1.5 at 1.0 (linear between)
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md E6)

rules.title: Chips cluster
rules.measure: chip counts in 0.5 m windows along the edges: variance over mean (20 chips or more)
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md E5)

rules.title: Tops lighter, drip edges darker and warmer
rules.measure: the edge layer's mean delta L* on top edges and on drip and lower edges; the b* shift on the drip edges
rules.pass: tops lighter (> 0); drip edges darker (< 0) with b* +1 to +4
rules.origin: L (roundG/research/cracks-edges-damage.md E9: tops chalked and rain-washed; drip edges dirt)

rules.title: Rust on steel by grade
rules.measure: the share of the steel (rails, posts; not aluminium sashes) where rust shows, a colour difference of 8 or more against clean (dE76; the rails' paint is darker than rust in places), against the rust amount
rules.pass: within 0.5-2x the grade share: 5 % at 0.25 (Ri3-4), 10 % at 0.5 (Ri4), 20 % at 0.75 (Ri4-5), 40 % at 1.0 (Ri5), log-linear between; under 0.1 only an upper limit
rules.origin: U (round G: 'High rust side looks a little weak'); L (ISO 4628-3 rust grades: Ri3 1 %, Ri4 8 %, Ri5 40-50 %)

rules.title: Each rust step shows
rules.measure: the rust control's steps: rusted share of the steel (as R1), the steel's mean colour difference against clean, and the rust area on the paint below
rules.pass: per step: share x 1.5 or more (or +10 points), mean colour difference x 1.5 or more (or +2), paint area grows
rules.origin: U (round G: 'the rust growth needs to be stronger between steps too')

tone.about: A0: mean D against clean on the exposed painted walls (the overall greying of the paint), by preset. Origin U: the round-7 'Light' level, 0.24, was picked as right for a moderately maintained block; round-7 Neglected (0.56) was not too dark, it lacked variety. Interpolate in E. Round G: Typical centred on Kept's round-F tone (0.18), since the user picked the Kept image as the 35-year default; Kept about 0.12; Worn about 0.27; Neglected unchanged. Round H: the bands stay on their E anchors; the new clock moves the presets onto them (Typical at 10.75 has round G's Kept look, Worn at 14.5 round G's Typical, Derelict at 19.8 round G's Worn; 27.1 is beyond Derelict, no preset).

revisions.change: span share 0.90 -> 0.60; marks >= 2 m CV >= 0.35, >= 0.25 when E >= 25
revisions.why: recalibrated on D_local of the photo walls after B2 moved to D_local (9 of 14 marks span >= 3 tiers; heavy walls CV 0.25-0.58)

revisions.change: storeys only
revisions.why: the first measurement counted the 0.6 m roof coping band and the splash zone as storeys; their steps are systematic and governed by A3/F1 and F3, not the storey-to-storey variety the rule is about

revisions.change: 0.002 tolerance at the lower bound
revisions.why: a fresh wall measured -0.00001

revisions.rule: C2 C3 F2 G1 H2 I1
revisions.change: pass on a fresh building (no weathering layers)
revisions.why: nothing to measure

revisions.change: streak levels S6-S7 -> S7-S8, threshold 2.5 -> 2.0
revisions.why: at S6-S7 only runs of 2 m and more reach 2.5 (synthetic test), which a 1.1 m balcony parapet cannot hold; at S7-S8 a 1 m streak gives 2.3-3.2 and a fringe of drips 0.8-1.3, so the rule still separates runs from drips and from stains (about 1.5)

revisions.change: ratio test only where a level holds >= 10 marks (was 3)
revisions.why: with 3 marks the next level's count has a Poisson 95 % range of about 1-9 around 4.5, so a perfect power law failed about 4 times in 10; the failures seen were S3-S4 counts of 3-10

revisions.change: bay to bay over neighbouring bays of the same kind
revisions.why: a stair tower next to a unit bay differs by construction (corner strips, its own stains), which is not the storey-to-storey jumping the rule is about

revisions.change: edge share counts chip centres instead of area
revisions.why: a spall 0.7 m across reaches past 10 cm from its edge by construction; the rule is about where breaks start

revisions.change: largest tier share <= 0.70 when E < 12 (0.60 above)
revisions.why: on the ordinary photo walls the faint tier holds 24-76 % of the stained area, the lightest walls the most; 0.60 was a craft number

revisions.change: ratio test from the level due at the amount downward
revisions.why: a few marks above the due level are merged chip clusters or tail outliers; at 0.3, five such marks against 93 at S8 failed a test meant for the distribution below the largest break

revisions.rule: D_local (A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, D1, E1)
revisions.change: measured on 1 - D, not on the weathered albedo
revisions.why: on the real facade, paint tones that differ between elements counted as stains (the clean round-7 building scored 1.9 % at T5+); the rules are about weathering
round-7 'Medium' (the user: acceptable 'for a more dystopian world') measures 0.039 and 0.004 under the corrected D_local

revisions.change: top band = the 1 m under the wall top
revisions.why: a penthouse above the roof was taken as the top edge

revisions.change: passes when there is no dark substrate
revisions.why: nothing to check is not missing data

revisions.change: geometric mean ratio over the levels in [2, 6], each step >= 1.3 (was every adjacent pair in [2, 6])
revisions.why: single levels carry about 15 % count noise from merging and caps; the pairwise window rejected power laws by chance, the mean keeps the slope and the step floor still catches a flattening

revisions.change: measured at both resolutions: 10 cm-2 m on the planes' clean albedo, 5 mm-10 cm and relief on 1 mm/px close-ups under the preview light
revisions.why: the photo values it was set from were measured on lit photographs, and the 50 px/m planes cannot resolve bands under 4 cm; the coat set (round E) left its macro scales to the shader, so the planes now carry the shader's coat clouding and joints

revisions.change: three parts: soiling against the material response at 4-50 cm, dirt in the joints, dirt in the coat's troughs at close range
revisions.why: the first version named a cavity map that only exists at close range; the material also shows at the scales the atlas carries (coat thickness, laps, joints)

revisions.change: new rule
revisions.why: a neglected north front (R50) passed every rule with algae blotches spread evenly over all storeys like camouflage; the rules did not say that algae follows water

revisions.change: marks >= 2 m: median >= 0.40, 10th percentile >= 0.33, floor 0.25 (was: every one >= 0.35); heavy walls 0.33, 0.25, 0.20 (was every one >= 0.25)
revisions.why: 0.35 was the smallest of the five big marks on the ordinary photo walls (0.35, 0.44, 0.44, 0.47, 0.68); a building carries 20-66 such marks, so its smallest falls under the photos' smallest by chance alone and the clause tightened with every mark. Builds that failed it had big-mark medians of 0.46-0.55 and 94-96 % of marks at 0.35 or more, against the photos' median of 0.44

revisions.change: at a sweep step where the control sets a layer to 0, rules that find nothing of that layer to measure pass as not applicable (they reported n/a, which counts as a failure)
revisions.why: streaks at 0 have no streak to place, so G1 cannot apply; the step is still checked by every other rule

revisions.change: step floor: 2 % of a plane, or half the layer's own area if smaller (was 2 % always)
revisions.why: a sparse layer's first step (streaks 0 -> 0.25) added hundreds of runs on 1.5 % of the wall and failed the absolute floor

revisions.change: coverage widens at the intensity frontier, the lowest tier under half the wall (was T2+); the intensity rise is counted once per two steps and may show as the top tier, the frontier, or the share of the layer at T4+ moving up (was: the top tier twice); not for damage
revisions.why: the soiling film covers the whole wall at T2+ at any amount (A2 asks for it), so T2+ could not widen; chips are full contrast at once; a sparse layer reaches T6 at its first step, so its top tier could not rise twice. The user's point was the area at each level of intensity: grime widens at T4+ 0.36 -> 0.70 -> 0.89 per step, stains' share at T4+ grows 0.19 -> 0.38 -> 0.51 -> 0.59

revisions.change: new: breaks have a sharp outline, a rough exposed floor and depth
revisions.why: the round-F damage sweep passed every rule while its large breaks were soft blobs (a falloff over half the radius) and its sub-pixel chips a row of equal 1 px dots. Under K4 the generator draws breaks as jagged polygons stretched along their edge with a 1 px edge, recessed 1-4 cm, sub-pixel chips as area coverage

revisions.change: size against distance measured within each hotspot (median rho), was pooled over all
revisions.why: hotspot sizes now follow a power law (references: most hotspots are runs of 0.5-3 cm bites, a few are shell breaks); pooled, a big hotspot's large far satellites against a small one's small near ones make a between-hotspot trend (rho -0.25 to -0.29) that hides the decline inside each (-0.74 to -0.81)

revisions.change: for damage a step has some of the layer at any break area (was 0.2 % of the wall)
revisions.why: realistic chipping is sparse: at amount 0.25 the breaks cover 0.04 % of the facade (1.5 m2 on the building) and grow x3.6, x2.4, x2.2 per step (K2); the 0.2 % floor was set for continuous layers

revisions.change: Typical takes Kept's round-F bands; Kept about 0.6x; Worn between Typical and Neglected; Neglected unchanged
revisions.why: round F: asked which image is the default street block (35 years, upkeep 0.9), the user picked Kept on the south front and on the 1:1 top floors; Neglected was 'about right'

revisions.change: 1.15 below E 13 (was 1.30 from E 8)
revisions.why: round F: 'the first jump from New to Kept has some excessive wear and ground level staining'; the photo walls (1.3-2.0) are older walls

revisions.change: adds the ground band's steps across the presets
revisions.why: round F: 'the jumps between the steps for the ground level could be more subtle'

revisions.change: new: seam crossings, long streaks and channels, a darker subset of streaks, a strong top step
revisions.why: round-F review of the streaks ('even the last is too weak', 'more long vertical streaks', 'near-whole building long streaks', 'attention to intersecting corners'); every threshold sits between round F's measured values and the new generator's

revisions.change: new: even steps
revisions.why: round F: the stain control's jumps shrank (x2.7, x1.8, x1.6 at T2+); the stain amount now adds sites on a perceptual curve (x2.8, x2.5, x2.4)

revisions.change: new family: organic growth
revisions.why: round-F review of the growth (dark green and rust brown when severe, light green or dull yellow when weak, grows outward); bands from the growth research (O1-O12)

revisions.change: new family: edges
revisions.why: round-F review: edge wear and discoloration visible at 0.25, as its own rule set; bands from the edges research (E5-E9)

revisions.change: new: spalled area, spall placement, crack density and widths, orientation, corner cracks, visibility, repairs
revisions.why: round-F review: cracks from hairline to pattern cracks, spalls exposing aggregate, derelict at 1.0; bands from the damage research (S1, S5, C1-C23)

revisions.change: new: colour variety
revisions.why: round-F review: more colour variety, calibrated on the photo walls

revisions.change: new: no accidental lattice
revisions.why: round-F review: the grime read as a grid; the 3.6 m material tile printed into the dirt

revisions.change: sources include the slab drip lines
revisions.why: the rule names ledge drip lines; the source map lacked them, so channel streaks below slabs counted as unsourced

revisions.change: measured on edge-damage clusters
revisions.why: delamination spalls (round G) are spread by K5/K6, not clustered round a hotspot

revisions.change: measured on the dirt
revisions.why: at damage 1.0 spalls and cracks cover the whole wall and lift its mean; the rule is about splash and ground dirt

revisions.change: arris rows and the edge layer left out
revisions.why: a chalked 1 px top arris raised the 'brightest 10 cm patch' reference, so every pixel near an edge read darker (T2+ 0.43 to 0.89 on one build)

revisions.change: years since repaint 0.665 x the cycle (was the full cycle); 17 % kept (was 22 %)
revisions.why: round-G review: Kept picked as the 35-year default again, and 'the current Kept becomes Typical, current Typical becomes Worn, Worn becomes Derelict, and a milder level of wear becomes Kept'; the fit puts the three presets on the old anchors within 0.04 E

revisions.change: kept 10 years at upkeep 1.0 (E 5.56, halfway); neglected renamed derelict; worn and typical unchanged in age and upkeep
revisions.why: the user's rename; Kept halfway keeps the tone steps even (A6)

revisions.change: order new < kept < typical < worn < derelict
revisions.why: the rename

revisions.change: new: seeds read as the same age
revisions.why: round-G review: seed 1 looked stronger; the seeds' film contrast differed by 0.50-0.69

revisions.change: new: even preset steps
revisions.why: round-G review called its ladder even; the new Kept must not crowd Typical

revisions.change: new: dark green and yellow mark families
revisions.why: round-G review of the dirt colour

revisions.change: new: green marks darken with age
revisions.why: round-G review: mould and mildew darken with age

revisions.change: beyond 5 % cover: W2-W3 cover >= 3x the open wall's (was a 50 % share of the growth)
revisions.why: the share could not hold where wet zones are 5.6 % of the wall: at 10 years M7's onsets put 12 % on the shaded open wall (round G's growth 0.75: W2-W3 share 0.35, cover ratio 9)

revisions.change: not judged from a wall with no growth yet
revisions.why: a front needs growth to grow from; round G failed its step from 0 on this

revisions.change: new: growth darkens and thickens with age
revisions.why: round-G review

revisions.change: new family metal: rust by grade on steel
revisions.why: round-G review: rust too little; round G's 0.25-8 % of the metal over 0.25-0.75

revisions.change: new: each rust step shows
revisions.why: round-G review: rust growth stronger between steps

revisions.change: years at 0.25-1.0: 3.1, 5.7, 10, 22 (were 3.7, 5.9, 10.2, 22); shaded open wall (W1) onset 3.5 years (was 3.0); colonies keep arriving up to 0.6 of a class's time scale after its onset (was 0)
revisions.why: emulated round-H growth sweep: M8 needs 5 % new patches per step (round G 3-5 %), M3 needs 70 % of young growth in W2-W3 (68 % at 5.9 years on the lighter Typical), L3 even steps (1.41 before, 1.30 after); M5, M7 and M9 kept

revisions.change: the intensity clause (the top tier, the frontier or the T4+ share rising once per two steps) is waived for rust, as for damage; R2 checks rust's steps
revisions.why: round-H rust sweep: rust on the steel reaches T6 from its first step and T4+ is 85-90 % of it at every step, so its intensity cannot rise; its coverage still widens 1.9x per step (L1's widening clause holds)

revisions.change: the steel's mean colour difference must rise x 1.5 or more (or +2) per step; was +2 only
revisions.why: round-H rust sweep: the even schedule (5, 10, 20, 40 % of the steel) doubles the share and the mean colour difference at every step (1.07, 2.22, 4.68, 10.25) but adds only +1.15 at the first; a schedule steep enough for +2 there (5, 16, 32, 58 %) broke L3's even steps (ratios 2.99, 1.93, 1.75). The share clause already reads 'x 1.5 or +10 points'

revisions.change: under the Worn clock (E 14.5) the coat's texture and the dust grain keep their absolute strength: their relative amplitude x (14.5 / E), capped at 2 (Kept 2.0, Typical 1.35); the joints as before
revisions.why: round-H Kept (E 5.6) failed B3 with 26 % of its soiling layer flat at 20 cm (17 % of D): a light film scaled from Typical's pattern was too even. A stronger grain alone fixed B3 but dropped J2 to 0.219, since grain is not the material; with the coat too, the rebuilt Kept has B3 0.011 (D) and 0.023 (soiling) and J2 0.297. The coat's micro-relief fills with dirt first and shows through a film until it is Worn-thick, which also lifts Typical's marginal J2 (seed 1 rebuilt: 0.256 to 0.291)

revisions.change: from clock E 19 the mark-gain search may go down to 0.45 (0.6 elsewhere)
revisions.why: round-H Derelict failed A1 with T6+ 0.0314 against 0.0299 at the 0.6 floor; its darkest tier is mostly soiling, growth and the ground band, so the marks give way (rebuilt at a gain of 0.47: T6+ 0.0290, every rule passing)

revisions.change: the soiling's foot boost gets a ragged reach, a texture that follows the coat and varies along the wall (heavier stretches, log amplitude 0.8), and a dark core in the bottom 25 cm with soil-splash specks, applied after the tone's saturation; all of it fades out from clock E 12 to 20
revisions.why: round-H B2: at the Typical clock the large (>= 2 m) marks are mostly foot bands, smooth because the boost was an exponential fade compressed by the saturation (inner CV 0.34-0.40; seed 1 passed at 0.414, seeds 2 and 3 failed at 0.377 and 0.385, grime 0.2 and 0.3 at 0.398; round G's Kept at the same clock 0.419). A grainy texture over the whole zone lifted seed 2's north front to 0.449 but cost J2 0.02; the coat texture, the along-wall variation and a grainy core only: 0.432 with J2 unchanged. Rebuilt Typical seed 1: 0.414 to 0.463; seeds 2 and 3 pass B2 (0.432, 0.414). Fading it out keeps Derelict's darkest tier (A1 T6+) in its band

revisions.change: above streak amount 0.5 the cells' opacity boost and colour for streaks fade toward the plain dirt, to 0.35 at 1.0; every preset and the sweeps' lower steps are unchanged
revisions.why: round-H streak sweep: 0.75 and 1.0 failed I3 (gable colour spread 4.18 and 4.7 against the photo walls' 4.0) because the cells' boost (about 1.5x at Typical) multiplied many overlapping streaks; gable after 3.29 and 2.88. Rebuilt, 0.75 passes every rule; 1.0 still fails C3 and H1 (striped: heavy streaks dominate the lighter Typical)
